messages:
elaine_cs: Need a concise SLA pack for Orion Labs renewal — uptime (90d), P99 gen+embed, regional availability, fallback rate, credit worked example. PDF for execs + CSVs for appendix.

matt_sre: I can pull uptime and P99. Which routes do we include?

elaine_cs: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Please include fallback counts and RPS so credit math is clear.

kai_eng: I'll export CSVs from Grafana and attach the PromQLs. P99 sample:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/generate\"}[5m])) by (le,region))
```

zoe_enablement: On onboarding, Orion still has webhook retries + schema validation open. I'll add an "Enablement status" block with suggested next sessions and a one-paragraph recommended action list.

matt_sre: I'll prepare the credit-calc worksheet (CSV + short worked example). Reminder: we weight minutes by regional traffic share and ignore micro-blips < 1m.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-5999 created and assigned to @kai_eng @matt_sre @zoe_enablement. Due date set: 2025-04-04.

elaine_cs: Thanks team — aim to have bundles by EOD 2025-04-03 so I can assemble the customer-facing scorecard and route to Legal. Flag anomalies here if you see them. :raised_hands:
